items.title: S&P upgrades KLA to ’A’ as AI chip demand bolsters scale and balance sheet
items.summary: Investing.com -- S&P Global Ratings raised its issuer credit and unsecured debt ratings on KLA Corporation (NASDAQ:KLAC) to 'A' from 'A-', citing accelerating operational scale from artificial intelligence infrastructure alongside disciplined balance-sheet management. The agency paired the upgrade with a stable outlook, reflecting expectations that the semiconductor equipment specialist will keep adjusted leverage well beneath 1.5x over the medium term.
